statement: You are given an integer array nums.
For each position i, count the elements to the right of i, at positions greater than i, whose value is strictly greater than nums[i]. They do not need to be adjacent or consecutive.
Return an array of the same length holding that count for every position. The original problem asks this for a list of query positions; here every position is queried.

examples.explanation: All six values after 3 are larger than it. After 7, only 8 and 10 are larger, and after 8 only 10 is.
Equal values do not count as greater, so every count is 0.
